name: Direct Single Scattering via Precomputed Integral
aliases: Direct Single Scattering (DSS) via Precomputed Integral
definition: Computes the direct single scattering radiance Ldss for a point P on a surface, accounting for absorption and out-scattering along the illumination ray and view ray, using a precomputed 2D integral function Γ.
summary: Direct Single Scattering via Precomputed Integral computes radiance using deterministic texture lookups of a precomputed Gamma function, eliminating Monte Carlo sampling noise and reducing cost at the expense of memory.
